title: Network Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 1 Year  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Vehicle:** Two\-wheeler is Mandatory

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Network Engineer with 1 year of experience** to manage network infrastructure, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and provide on\-site technical support to clients. The candidate should be comfortable travelling to client locations and handling field\-level network support.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain network devices such as **routers, switches, access points, and firewalls**.
* Troubleshoot **LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and network connectivity issues**.
* Perform network cabling, configuration, testing, and basic troubleshooting.
* Provide **on\-site technical support** at client locations.
* Travel to client sites as required for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor network performance and resolve connectivity issues within the required timeframe.
* Configure and troubleshoot **TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and basic routing**.
* Maintain proper documentation of network installations, configurations, and service activities.
* Coordinate with clients and internal technical teams to resolve network\-related issues.
* Provide regular updates on assigned service tickets and field activities.

Requirements

* **1 year of experience** as a Network Engineer or in a similar networking role.
* Good knowledge of **LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, routing, and switching**.
* Hands\-on experience with routers, switches, Wi\-Fi devices, and network troubleshooting.
* Good problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to **client locations**.
* **Valid two\-wheeler and driving licence are mandatory.**
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a field\-support environment.

Preferred Skills

* CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge is an added advantage.
* Experience with **CCTV, firewall, access points, or structured cabling** will be an advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on different client networking environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to network installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Professional growth and learning opportunities.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Implementation Architect
description:
**Implementation Architect**


**Location: Bengaluru/Coimbatore**


**About AppViewX:**



AppViewX is the only machine and agent identity security company built for the AI and quantum era, bringing together discovery, automation, control, and intelligence. The AVX Platform helps enterprises reduce risk by providing complete visibility and governance over every machine and AI agent identity, automating their lifecycle, controlling their access, and proving compliance at the speed business demands. Trusted by global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, and technology, AppViewX is recognized as a leader in the IDC 2026 MarketScape for Certificate Lifecycle Management and KuppingerCole's 2025 Non\-Human Identity Management Leadership Compass. For more information, users can visit appviewx.com.


**Our Values**



Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.


* **We Do What We Say:** We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.
* **We Are Trusted Experts:** We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need.
* **We Raise the Bar:** We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results.
* **We Win Together:** We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates.


If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.


**What will you be responsible for?**



Customer Success Implementation Architects play a key role in driving Customer onboarding, Solutioning and ongoing adoption and usage of AppViewX product. You will lead the implementation of AppViewX solutions for automating customer IT Network infrastructure and Public Key Infrastructure. You will combine your deep technical knowledge with an understanding of customer business objectives /challenges help customers maximize the value of AppViewX products. You will work in the Customer Success team looking at opportunities to automate service offerings around different AppViewX products, tools and processes.


**Onboarding**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Address customer objectives/success criteria with in\-depth technical attention to help customer Go\-live quickly.


**Adoption and Value Quantification**


* Working with our Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Design Architects, implement additional AppViewX technology to solve specific business challenges for our new customers
* Act as a trusted technical advisor by assisting customers navigate technical challenges throughout the implementation process.
* Identify new use cases as part of account growth/renewal strategy


**Customer Experience/Engagement**


* Use your experiences working with customers to provide feedback to the rest of the AppViewX organization on how we can improve the customer experience, speed time\-to\-value, and create greater benefits for our customers
* Use your experience to look at opportunities to automate, develop tools that aid your team to reduce man hours.
* Contribute to Customer Business Reviews highlighting potential areas of improvements.


 **Roadmap Planning**


* Partner closely with other cross\-functional team members (e.g., sales, product management, support, services, delivery) to translate business needs and product requirements into new solutions
* Work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to prioritize product enhancements and long term roadmap based on customer/industry priorities.


**What do we require?**


* Minimum 5 years' experience working in a technical implementation role
* Open to work in US Shift
* Minimum 3 years' experience working in customer\-facing technical roles (such as Customer Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Subject Matter Expert), preferably in a post\-sales capacity, for a SaaS company with enterprise software products
* Love of programming, solid coding skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Java.
* Experience with web service development and using RESTful APIs
* Understanding of configuration management tools such as Chef/Puppet/Vagrant/Ansible/Salt preferred
* Experience with building Jenkins/automated test frameworks preferred
* Domain knowledge on **PKI**, DNS, Active Directory,cloud, ADCS, CRL, OCSP, and associated cryptographic standards
* + Experience with Certificate Life Cycle management/operations
	+ Experience with PKI implementation processes
	+ Experience with PKI integrations, MS Intune, SCEP, other enrollment practices
* Hands on experience with:
* + Kubernetes
	+ Linux / Windows server management
	+ Apache, IIS \- application expertise
* CISSP / CISM / CISA is preferred
* Excellent organization, troubleshooting, problem solving, deployment and multitasking skills with ability to learn new technology at a fast pace
* Worked and interacted with F500 organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills


**Why AppViewX?**



AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. Over the years, we grew our diverse team, perfected our automation platform, and expanded our global footprint to India, North America, United Kingdom, and Australia. Today, we are headquartered in New York City and have come a long way by optimizing opportunities to create lasting relationships with enterprises, gaining unshakable customer trust along the way.



AppViewX is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is AppViewX's policy to afford equal employment opportunities to all employees regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, citizenship status, gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, pregnancy, disability, genetic information, arrest record, or other protected class under state, federal, or local law.

title: IT Infrastructure Service Desk Agent
description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.


In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.


In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6\.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description** **Job Title: Service Desk Engineer**  

**Work Location: Coimbatore, India**  

**Reporting to: Service Desk manager**  

**Mode of work: Permanent role**  

**Shift Timings: 12PM – 9PM or 3\.30PM – 12\.30AM**  

  

**Job Description**  

  

Are you passionate about IT and eager to grow your career in a dynamic, international environment? Join our Service Desk team in Coimbatore, India, where you’ll be the first point of contact for IT support across Europe, we´re looking for services desk.  

As a Service Desk Engineer, you’ll support over 20,000 users across 500 sites in Europe, ensuring smooth operations for our laboratories, offices, and VIP users. You’ll handle a wide range of IT issues, from Microsoft 365 to workplace hardware, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality service.

  

You will support our internal users across Europe from Coimbatore.  

  

**How can you help us?**  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide 1st line IT support for end users across Europe.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint) Windows 10/11Identity \& Access Management Printing and patching (desktop/server) Application triage and routing Register, classify, and follow up on tickets using internal processes.
* Escalate complex issues to 2nd line support when needed. Contribute to documentation, knowledge base articles, and service catalog improvements.
* Identify and document workarounds and recurring issues.

 **Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree or comparable education  

  

**Experience: 3 year\+** Basic experience in a Service Desk or IT support role is expected.

* Candidates must possess strong communication skills in English, French, and Spanish.
* Solid troubleshooting skills, especially with Windows and Microsoft 365\.
* A strong customer service mindset and initiative to resolve issues efficiently.
* A proactive, “can\-do” attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

**Personal Skills:** Team Player, Smart worker, Quick learner, Willingness to work in off business hours with On\-call setup in needed.  

**Nice to have:** Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, or networking.  

Familiarity with BMC Helix ticketing system. ITIL Foundation certification. Knowledge of Azure, SCCM, or Intune. Windows Patching management for end user devices

**What else should I know?**  

This is a fantastic opportunity to build your IT career in a highly collaborative, multilingual environment. You’ll be part of a team that values continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing. If you're motivated by problem\-solving and thrive in a fast\-paced support role, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
### **Job Information**


* Job Type Permanant (Full Time)
* Work Experience 10 \- 14 years
* City Hyderabad
* Country India
### **Job Description**


**Senior Infrastructure Engineer**

 *Senior / Lead Level \| Full\-Time \| Hyderabad or Coimbatore, India (Hybrid/Onsite as applicable)*

**Role Summary**
----------------

  

We are looking for an experienced Senior Infrastructure Engineer with 10–14 years of experience to manage, automate, and secure enterprise infrastructure across hybrid cloud and on\-premises environments. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Linux/Windows administration, containerization and orchestration, identity \& access management, and infrastructure automation, along with a track record of supporting mission\-critical industrial and enterprise applications through their full operational lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage and support enterprise server environments and industrial/application infrastructure, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Design, build, and maintain Helm charts and containerized workloads; lead Docker/Podman to Kubernetes (K3S) migrations and orchestration.
* Integrate applications with centralized identity providers (Microsoft Entra ID, AD, LDAP) using Keycloak to deliver SSO and unified authentication.
* Develop and maintain automation and health\-check workflows using Ansible, Python, and Bash to reduce manual operational effort.
* Own CI/CD pipeline design, deployment automation, and GitLab administration, including troubleshooting runner and build failures.
* Drive infrastructure and application vulnerability remediation, OS/kernel patching, and security compliance activities.
* Lead disaster recovery (DR) drills, environment migrations, and release/change deployment activities.
* Provide L2/L3 incident, problem, and change management support following ITIL\-aligned processes.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional infrastructure, application, and vendor teams on server delivery, patching, and network segmentation.
* Support onboarding of new applications, POCs, and technology evaluations to enhance platform scalability and operational efficiency.
* Manage SSL certificate lifecycle and monitoring/alerting configuration across the environment.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 10–14 years of experience in Linux, Windows, VMware, Cloud, and Automation technologies.
* Hands\-on expertise in Ansible, Python, Bash/PowerShell scripting, and Git\-based CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes (K3S), Helm, Docker, and Podman in production environments.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Experience with identity and access management platforms: LDAP, FreeIPA, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, and SSO integration.
* Solid understanding of ITIL\-based incident, problem, and change management practices.

**Technical Skills Matrix**
---------------------------

 **Skill Category**

 **Representative Tools / Technologies**

  

DevOps \& Automation

  

Ansible, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Git, CI/CD Pipelines, Helm, Kubernetes (K3S)

  

Cloud \& Virtualization

  

AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud (OCI), VMware, Docker, Podman

  

Operating Systems

  

Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Solaris), Windows Server

  

Identity \& Security

  

AD, LDAP, FreeIPA, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO Integration, Vulnerability Management

  

Infrastructure \& Monitoring

  

Server Provisioning, Monitoring \& Alerting, Disaster Recovery (DR), Performance Tuning

  

IT Service Management

  

Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management (ITIL)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) and/or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) or equivalent Microsoft infrastructure certification.
* Prior experience supporting industrial/IoT or retail\-technology assets (e.g., self\-driving vehicles, smart checkout systems) is a plus.
* Experience with orchestration/flow tools beyond Ansible (e.g., custom automation or low\-code flow platforms) is a plus.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in computer applications, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Reduced manual operational effort through automation of repetitive infrastructure tasks.
* Stable, secure, and audit\-ready infrastructure with proactive vulnerability remediation.
* Reliable CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments supporting rapid, low\-risk releases.
* Strong cross\-team collaboration enabling smooth onboarding of new applications and platforms.
